title: The Four Clever Brothers (The Dragon of the Rock)
summary: The astronomer located the dragon, the thief rescued the princess, the hunter shot the beast, and the tailor stitched their boat in the tempest....
full_text:
The astronomer located the dragon, the thief rescued the princess, the hunter shot the beast, and the tailor stitched their boat in the tempest.

The king rewarded all four equally, teaching that the harmony of unique talents builds an invincible society.
moral: Uniting complementary masteries accomplishes deeds beyond the reach of isolated power.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
